name: TitleScreen
_doc: The title screen on join (src/client/Menus), Field Grimoire's map table (UI overhaul, user 2026-10-30): the live match behind it (src/client/MatchCam), dimmed more on the left; RUNEN / KRIEG stacked on the left; under it a trench line drawn the way WW1 trench maps drew them (src/client/Ink, cut short under the name: "cut it where i showed"); 'For <team>' with the team's name in its colour (Palette UI.Grimoire.Name; no 'Kingdom of'); the menu as words: Play on a torn ink plate, the others faded, each with a faint rune inscription at its right edge (`runes`: Config/Runes names; Play's in the team's magic colour); the live match's sketch map (src/client/SketchMap; no 'you' marker) right of centre, tilted, the front and head counts under it. Sizes in reference pixels at theme.scale.referenceHeight. One font, the game's basic font. Colours: Config/Palette UI.Grimoire (theme.palette). Kinds beyond the usual: overlay (a black dimming, `from` / `to` transparency left to right), trench, sketchmap; `slab` puts a button on the ink plate; `aspect` keeps a group's width / height; `fade` is a word's resting transparency; `shade` its dark edge.
